task.title: To create a Search and Select action
task.shortdesc: Rakesh Singh Click on the arrow beneath the Actions button and select Search and Select

step.cmd: Click on the arrow beneath the Actions button and select Search and Select.
On the Options tab, under Search and Select Action, type an Action Name. Use a descriptive name, for example, Search Opportunities.
Click the Enable Favorite Filters check box to enable Favorite Filters for this action. Refer to Enabling and Using Favorite Filters in Queries for more information.
In Searchable Fields, select one or more fields that will be displayed to the end user as input fields at runtime.

In the Result Selection, decide whether the user can select single or multiple results that are returned to Excel, and select a Result selection. (You can only select Single for an Individual object, or Multiple for a List object.)

In the Fields to Display in Search Results, select one more fields to display in the search results. Select a check box in the Sort By column to choose the primary sort. Note: At runtime, the user can also sort by any column when the results are displayed. You can also reorder the result columns using the Arrows to the right of the grid.
Add filters as required. Refer to the Query Action for details on how to create filters.
